item.title: What to know about the death of Congolese man in Ireland
item.description: Hundreds of people in Ireland are calling for justice after the death of a Congolese man restrained by security guards in Dublin

item.title: Israeli security minister who taunted flotilla activists has a record of extreme actions
item.description: Israel's far-right national security minister has sparked global outrage after promoting a video of himself taunting activists from a flotilla to Gaza who were detained by his police force

item.title: This hard-line Iranian general is a major player in talks with US over war
item.description: A hard-line Iranian general linked to notorious attacks at home and abroad is believed to have seized a place near the center of power as negotiations with the United States hang in the balance

item.title: UK offers cheaper chocolate and tickets to the zoo in bid to ease cost of living squeeze
item.description: The British government is offering cheaper chocolate and discounted theme park entry to ease the cost-of-living squeeze triggered by the Iran war

item.title: Russia holds nuclear drills on land, sea and air, joined by its ally Belarus
item.description: Trucks carrying intercontinental ballistic missiles rumbled over forest roads, submarines set sail from Arctic and Pacific ports, and crews scrambled into warplanes as Russia and neighboring Belarus held the final stage of their joint nuclear drills

item.title: Philippine justice chief orders arrest of senator wanted by the ICC over Duterte-era killings
item.description: The Philippines justice chief has ordered the enforcement of an International Criminal Court warrant for a senator wanted on an alleged crime against humanity charge
